title: A graveyard card you cannot play says why
notes: Presentation only (R1571000): a card in your own graveyard that a permission admits but no play of which is listed carries playReason in the view, shown in the graveyard's sheet. Only the view differs, which the classifier's games read as a different play.

player.title: A graveyard card you can't play says why
text: No card plays differently: your own graveyard only says why a card it admits cannot be played.
